1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are specifically formatted proofs of claim documents;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include debtor-specific information and creditor claim amounts;
and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations via automated electronic submission to each organization's designated filing system.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step comprises transforming a single creditor data record into multiple court-specific document formats.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim that specifies the debtor identity, claim amount, and claim category;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by transforming the data records into court-compliant proof of claim documents, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations having different formatting requirements;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations via automated electronic submission to each bankruptcy court's designated electronic filing system.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step comprises converting a single creditor data record into multiple court-specific proof of claim formats.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol.

10. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site.

11. (Original) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day.

12. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record.
